mentions.name: Machine Learning for Drug Discovery
mentions.description: A book on machine learning for drug discovery, currently in progress with Manning. The author is writing two appendix sections on knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning that expand coverage of material from earlier chapters, and plans to also publish condensed versions of these appendix sections as freely available articles while finishing chapter 11 to stay on schedule for full publication.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on writing two appendix sections on knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning for Machine Learning for Drug Discovery [1], which were initiated as tangents to expand coverage of material from a few earlier chapters. I hope to also write these appendix sections up as freely available articles (at least in a condensed form).
